messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Sorry, Neil, it should have gone out on the 3rd and it hasn't. Here's the real state: your Thor P2 ships from the US warehouse, and that stock is checked in and covers orders up to Shop····, so yours is in it. It's queued for dispatch now, nothing shipped yet, tracking goes to your iCloud address the moment the label prints. You can watch the stock side here: heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Also, the H15 answer came back: the Scrypt engine draws about 250 W for 1.05 GH/s, roughly 0.238 J/MH. That's the Scrypt side alone, not the full ~500 W unit.
Thanks, do you have a shipping date for my Thor?

I don't have a new date to the day, and I won't guess one. What I can tell you: the units are on the shelf at the US warehouse and your order is inside the batch they cover, so it's in the dispatch queue rather than waiting on stock. Orders go out oldest first, and yours is from September 8, so it's near the front. The tracking email lands the same day the label prints.
